objective: Find whether saved observations can provide a compatible common unseen whole-sweep set for the three changed CM-E1 applied models.
rationale: CM-E1 reports no common unseen sweep for any changed applied-model comparison. Data lineage feasibility can change the next research decision without numerical experiments.

explanations.explanation: Training overlap or inconsistent validation folds obscures a useful predictive distinction.
Model bias/identifiability dominates, so fair prediction may remain uninformative about physical accuracy.

route_plans.exact_scope: Identity and lineage inspection of three archived CM-E1 histories plus at most twelve additional saved dataset/manifest files.
route_plans.discriminating_observation: An observation-matched compatible common whole-sweep set is verifiably outside both applied models' complete training and preprocessing/selection lineage.
route_plans.reopening_condition: Verified compatible unseen saved data, or separately authorized later collection/holdout construction.
route_plans.limitation: Finding a common fold establishes feasibility only, not model accuracy.

route_plans.exact_scope: Preserve as an alternative; no numerical experiment or source modification in this trial.
route_plans.discriminating_observation: A saved-data feasibility failure would prioritize scoping a separate model-adequacy assignment.
route_plans.reopening_condition: Reviewed feasibility outcome, with later numerical work separately scoped.

method: Verify compressed and raw input hashes using CM-E1 inputs.json. Decode saved envelopes without fitting or residual scoring.
Search only the producer session named by inputs.json and matching repository dataset files; inspect at most twelve additional files.

Compare observation contents and full training lineage, including anchor contributors, chosen spool fit and preprocessing/selection use. Check machine/frame/units, encoder origin, spool/layering and collection settings. Unknown lineage is unverified, never unseen.
Return a source/lineage matrix with hashes and evidence links; preserve missing data and stop at budget. Make no new membership rule.

found.observation: A compatible common unseen set is verified.
found.decision: Keep current defaults; record feasibility. A later scoring experiment requires separate scope because this trial forbids new numerical experiments.

absent_or_unknown.observation: No set qualifies within the named sources or lineage is unknown.
absent_or_unknown.decision: Predictive safety remains inconclusive; park further membership-rule tuning and scope the model-adequacy alternative.

tool_failure.observation: A reader or launch failure prevents the scoped inspection.
tool_failure.decision: Preserve partial evidence, repair the named capability, and make no scientific inference.

review: A separately dispatched fresh-context reviewer must inspect frozen selected evidence first. No numerical repetition is requested. No review has occurred.
